card.name: Capital P or G starting a new term
card.fires_on: The first letter piece P or G that begins a new term after a heading, table label or 'with'. Examples are P in PPIs and G in Gastrointestinal, Gout or Ganciclovir.

modes.label: P before PIs
modes.description: The letter P right after 'with', beginning the abbreviation PPIs (proton pump inhibitors).
modes.example: Consult the labeling of concomitantly used drugs to obtain further information about interactions with<< P>>PIs.

modes.label: G starting a heading or table entry
modes.description: The letter G opening a section heading, table row or drug name, such as Gastrointestinal, Gout or Ganciclovir.
modes.example: monitor patients for signs of cardiac ischemia.<< G>>astrointestinal Bleeding, Ulceration
